name: nerdctl
description: Docker-compatible CLI for containerd with rootless mode and experimental Windows container support

nerdctl.description: ContaiNERD CTL - Docker-compatible CLI for containerd with compose, rootless, eStargz, OCIcrypt support
nerdctl.usage:
nerdctl run -it --rm alpine:latest sh
nerdctl build -t myapp .
nerdctl compose up -d
nerdctl container prune -f
nerdctl system info
